name: Retrieves all groups of a domain or of a user given a userKey (paginated).
description: Retrieves all groups of a domain or of a user given a userKey (paginated). GET /admin/directory/v1/groups
context:
GET /admin/directory/v1/groups
Retrieves all groups of a domain or of a user given a userKey (paginated).
Optional: domain (query) — The domain name. Use this field to get groups from only one domain. To return all domains for a customer account, use the `customer` query parameter instead.; pageToken (query) — Token to specify next page in the list; maxResults (query) — Maximum number of results to return. Max allowed value is 200.; userKey (query) — Email or immutable ID of the user if only those groups are to be listed, the given user is a member of. If it's an ID, it should match with the ID of the user object. Cannot be used with the `customer` parameter.; sortOrder (query) — Whether to return results in ascending or descending order. Only of use when orderBy is also used; orderBy (query) — Column to use for sorting results; customer (query) — The unique ID for the customer's Google Workspace account. In case of a multi-domain account, to fetch all groups for a customer, use this field instead of `domain`. You can also use the `my_customer` alias to represent your account's `customerId`. The `customerId` is also returned as part of the [Users](https://developers.google.com/workspace/admin/directory/v1/reference/users) resource. You must provide either the `customer` or the `domain` parameter.; query (query) — Query string search. Contains one or more search clauses, each with a field, operator, and value. For complete documentation, go to [Search for groups](https://developers.google.com/workspace/admin/directory/v1/guides/search-groups).; fields (query) — Field mask limiting which response fields are returned, e.g. sheets.properties.

name: Checks whether the given user is a member of the group.
description: Checks whether the given user is a member of the group. Checks whether the given user is a member of the group. GET /admin/directory/v1/groups/{groupKey}/hasMember/{memberKey}
context:
GET /admin/directory/v1/groups/{groupKey}/hasMember/{memberKey}
Checks whether the given user is a member of the group. Membership can be direct or nested, but if nested, the `memberKey` and `groupKey` must be entities in the same domain or an `Invalid input` error is returned. To check for nested memberships that include entities outside of the group's domain, use the [`checkTransitiveMembership()`](https://cloud.google.com/identity/docs/reference/rest/v1/groups.memberships/checkTransitiveMembership) method in the Cloud Identity Groups API.
Required: memberKey (path) — Identifies the user member in the API request. The value can be the user's primary email address, alias, or unique ID.; groupKey (path) — Identifies the group in the API request. The value can be the group's email address, group alias, or the unique group ID.
Optional: fields (query) — Field mask limiting which response fields are returned, e.g. sheets.properties.
